supporting_observations.claim: Zeek records show WS-RIYER-01 connecting to the explicit proxy at 10.20.20.30:8080 at 13:40:22, 13:46:08, 13:50:43, 13:56:11, 14:00:50, and 14:05:33 UTC. The connection byte counts are similar across several of these sessions.

The spacing of those proxy connections is roughly five minutes, consistent with the cadence of the approved DataGrid updater described in the environment context, but the records do not identify the process or the external destination.

The workstation also made Kerberos and LDAP connections to the domain controller during the review period. Some LDAP sessions had comparatively large response volumes; the available records do not reveal the queries or their purpose.
Before the telemetry gap, raj.iyer had an interactive logon on WS-RIYER-01 and Explorer ran under that account; this does not establish which processes or user actions occurred during the gap.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied sensor-coverage metadata reports that WS-RIYER-01 WinSec and Sysmon records were not collected from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC, overlapping the alert window.

The supplied sensor-coverage metadata reports that proxy access logs were not collected during 13:30–14:10 UTC, so the proxy sessions cannot be mapped here to external destinations or request details.
Zeek connection records show traffic to the proxy, not the HTTPS destination behind it; the supplied evidence does not include the relevant DNS or TLS details needed to resolve that destination.
claims_not_established: Whether the periodic proxy sessions were generated by the approved DataGrid updater or by another process.
Which external hostname or service the proxy sessions reached, and whether the destination was approved.
Whether data was uploaded, downloaded, or otherwise transferred in a malicious manner.
Whether the LDAP activity was routine or represented reconnaissance; the records do not provide the LDAP queries or process attribution.
The available evidence does not establish either malicious activity or a benign explanation.
additional_evidence_needed: Recover or obtain PROXY-LV-01 access logs for 13:30–14:10 UTC, including CONNECT destinations, request details, user agent, status, and byte counts.
Obtain the missing WS-RIYER-01 WinSec and Sysmon telemetry for the same period, especially process creation and process-to-network attribution.
Review available Zeek DNS and TLS metadata for WS-RIYER-01 during the window to identify destination hostnames and TLS characteristics.
Verify whether dgupdate.exe was installed and running on WS-RIYER-01 at the relevant times, including its path, signature, and process/network activity.
If available, obtain domain-controller LDAP query or directory-audit details to determine what the workstation queried.
